```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
# Load pb-vnf_230414-240901.rds
pb_vnf <- readRDS("pb-vnf_230414-240901.rds")

# Load cb_wells_prod.rds
cb_wells_prod <- readRDS("cb_wells_prod.rds") # pretty cleaned



pb_vnf<-pb_vnf[pb_vnf$date>="2023-05-01" & pb_vnf$date<="2024-05-31",] # study period
```
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Load cb_wells_prod.rds
cb_wells_prod <- readRDS("cb_wells_prod.rds") # pretty cleaned


cb_wells_prod<-cb_wells_prod[cb_wells_prod$prod_date>="2023-05-01" & cb_wells_prod$prod_date<="2024-05-31",]
head(cb_wells_prod)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
cb_wells_prod_density <- cb_wells_prod %>% 
  select(api, uog_lon, uog_lat) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  rename(lon = uog_lon, lat = uog_lat)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Define the central point (e.g., using latitude and longitude coordinates)
central_point <- st_sfc(st_point(c(-104.1089, 32.2961)), crs = 4326)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
central_point_utm <- st_transform(central_point, crs = 32613) # Adjust CRS based on location (e.g., UTM zone)

# Convert central point to WGS84 for leaflet
central_point_wgs84 <- st_transform(central_point, crs = 4326)
```


```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
pb_vnf_high_temp <- pb_vnf %>%
  filter(temp_bb >= 1600)

# Convert points to an sf object and transform to the same UTM projection
flare_points_sf <- st_as_sf(pb_vnf_high_temp, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 32613)

# Create a 20 km buffer around the central point
buffer_20km <- st_buffer(central_point_utm, dist = 20000) # 20 km in meters

# Identify points within the buffer
flare_points_in_buffer20 <- flare_points_sf %>%
  st_filter(buffer_20km)

# Transform buffer back to WGS84 (EPSG 4326) for leaflet
buffer_20km_wgs84 <- st_transform(buffer_20km, crs = 4326)

# Filter points within the 20 km buffer and transform them back to WGS84
flare_points_in_buffer20 <- flare_points_sf %>%
  st_filter(buffer_20km) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Points outside the buffer
flare_points_outside_buffer <- flare_points_sf %>%
  filter(!st_within(., buffer_20km, sparse = FALSE)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

cb_wells_prod<-cb_wells_prod[cb_wells_prod$prod_date>="2023-05-01" & cb_wells_prod$prod_date<="2024-05-31",] # study period

cb_wells_prod <- cb_wells_prod %>% 
  rename(lon = uog_lon, lat = uog_lat)

# Convert points to an sf object and transform to the same UTM projection
well_points_sf <- st_as_sf(cb_wells_prod, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 32613)


# Filter points within the 20 km buffer and transform them back to WGS84
wells_in_buffer20 <- well_points_sf %>%
  st_filter(buffer_20km) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

# Points outside the buffer
wells_outside_buffer <- well_points_sf %>%
  filter(!st_within(., buffer_20km, sparse = FALSE)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)
```

# Maps
## Figure 1: Spatial Density Map of Wells and Flares (separately)
### Wells
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
# Create leaflet map
leaflet(cb_wells_prod_density) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addHeatmap(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, intensity = 1, blur = 20, max = 0.05, radius = 15) %>%
 
  # Add central point
  addMarkers(data = central_point_wgs84, popup = "Central Point (The Trailer)", label = "The Trailer") %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", colors = c("blue", "red"), labels = c("Low", "High"),
             title = "Density")

```

### Flares
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
# Create leaflet map
leaflet(pb_vnf) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addHeatmap(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, intensity = 1, blur = 20, max = 0.05, radius = 15) %>%
  # Add central point
  addMarkers(data = central_point_wgs84, popup = "Central Point (The Trailer)", label = "The Trailer") %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", colors = c("blue", "red"), labels = c("Low", "High"),
             title = "Density")
```

## Figure 2: Map of Flare, Well Locations and the 20km Buffer
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Plot with leaflet
leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  # Add buffer (20 km around central point)
  addPolygons(data = buffer_20km_wgs84, color = "blue", fillOpacity = 0.2, 
              popup = "20 km Buffer") %>%
  # Add central point
  addMarkers(data = central_point_wgs84, popup = "Central Point (The Trailer)", label = "The Trailer") %>%
  # Add points inside the buffer in green
  addCircleMarkers(data = flare_points_in_buffer20, color = "green", radius = 3,
                   label = ~"Flares within 20km buffer") %>%
  # Add points inside the buffer in green
  addCircleMarkers(data = wells_in_buffer20, color = "green", radius = 3,
                   label = ~"Wells within 20km buffer") %>%
  # Add points outside the buffer in orange
  addCircleMarkers(data = flare_points_outside_buffer, color = "orange", radius = 3,
                   label = ~"Flares outside 20km buffer") %>%
  # Add points outside the buffer in orange
  addCircleMarkers(data = wells_outside_buffer, color = "orange", radius = 3,
                   label = ~"Wells outside 20km buffer") %>%
  addLegend("bottomright", colors = c("green", "orange"), labels = c("Inside Buffer", "Outside Buffer"),
            title = "Flares & Wells Location")
```


# Summary Statistics
## Table 2: Table 2: Summary Statistics For Production of Wells in the Buffer
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

# Ensure prod_date is in Date format
wells_in_buffer20 <- wells_in_buffer20 %>%
  mutate(month = format(prod_date, "%Y-%m"))  # Extract month and year from prod_date

# Calculate the required summary statistics
wells_summary_data <- wells_in_buffer20 %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarize(
    num_oil_wells = sum(prod_type_p == "OIL", na.rm = TRUE),
    num_gas_wells = sum(prod_type_p == "GAS", na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_monthly_oil = mean(monthly_oil, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_monthly_oil = median(monthly_oil, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_monthly_oil = IQR(monthly_oil, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_monthly_gas = mean(monthly_gas, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_monthly_gas = median(monthly_gas, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_monthly_gas = IQR(monthly_gas, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load necessary library
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

wells_summary_data_table <- wells_summary_data %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

# Assuming wells_summary_data is already created
wells_summary_data_table <- wells_summary_data_table %>%
  rename(
    "Year & Month" = month,
    "Number of Oil Wells" = num_oil_wells,
    "Number of Gas Wells" = num_gas_wells,
    "Average Monthly Production of Oil" = avg_monthly_oil,
    "Median Monthly Production of Oil" = median_monthly_oil,
    "IQR of Monthly Oil Production" = iqr_monthly_oil,
    "Average Monthly Production of Gas" = avg_monthly_gas,
    "Median Monthly Production of Gas" = median_monthly_gas,
    "IQR of Monthly Gas Production" = iqr_monthly_gas
  )



# Display the summary data in a Kable table
wells_summary_data_table %>%
  kable("pipe", align = "c", caption = "Summary of Monthly Oil and Gas Production Data") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")

#  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = F)

# Save the table as an HTML file
# save_kable(table_html, "wells_summary_data_table.html")
```
## Table 3: Summary Statistics For Sound Frequencies
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
load("sound_pollutant_met_data.rdata")

# Define the variables of interest without LAleq
frequency_variables_of_interest <- c(
  "LAFmax", "LAFmin", "LCpeak", "LAeq",  "LCeq", "LZeq 12.5Hz", 
  "LZeq 16Hz", "LZeq 20Hz", "LZeq 25Hz", "LZeq 31.5Hz", "LZeq 40Hz", 
  "LZeq 50Hz", "LZeq 63Hz", "LZeq 80Hz", "LZeq 100Hz", "LZeq 125Hz", 
  "LZeq 160Hz", "LZeq 200Hz", "LZeq 250Hz", "LZeq 315Hz", "LZeq 400Hz", 
  "LZeq 500Hz", "LZeq 630Hz", "LZeq 800Hz", "LZeq 1kHz", "LZeq 1.25kHz", 
  "LZeq 1.6kHz", "LZeq 2kHz", "LZeq 2.5kHz", "LZeq 3.15kHz", "LZeq 4kHz", 
  "LZeq 5kHz", "LZeq 6.3kHz", "LZeq 8kHz", "LZeq 10kHz", "LZeq 12.5kHz", 
  "LZeq 16kHz"
)

frequency_summary_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = frequency_variables_of_interest,
  Min = NA,
  First_Qu = NA,
  Median = NA,
  Mean = NA,
  Third_Qu = NA,
  Max = NA
)

# Step 5: For the variables that exist in the dataset, calculate the summary statistics
for (var in frequency_variables_of_interest) {
  if (var %in% colnames(sound_pollutant_met_data)) {
    summary_values <- summary(sound_pollutant_met_data[[var]])
    frequency_summary_data[frequency_summary_data$Variable == var, "Min"] <- summary_values["Min."]
    frequency_summary_data[frequency_summary_data$Variable == var, "First_Qu"] <- summary_values["1st Qu."]
    frequency_summary_data[frequency_summary_data$Variable == var, "Median"] <- summary_values["Median"]
    frequency_summary_data[frequency_summary_data$Variable == var, "Mean"] <- summary_values["Mean"]
    frequency_summary_data[frequency_summary_data$Variable == var, "Third_Qu"] <- summary_values["3rd Qu."]
    frequency_summary_data[frequency_summary_data$Variable == var, "Max"] <- summary_values["Max."]
  }
}

# Step 6: Rename columns to fix the issue
colnames(frequency_summary_data) <- c("Variable", "Min", "1st Qu", "Median", "Mean", "3rd Qu", "Max")

# Step 7: Print the summary table using kable
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

table_html <- kable(frequency_summary_data, format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = F)

table_html

```
